entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A flying ship, the focal point of the Legacy weapon, whose crew searches the planes for the pieces of the Legacy.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.description: A cache of powerful artifacts which, assembled into a doomsday weapon, can destroy the dark powers that invade Dominaria.

entities.name: Thran Tome
entities.description: An important artifact of the Legacy whose contents change depending on who reads it, including the Legacy's components and operation.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The evil lord poised to invade his one-time home, Dominaria.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Brother who, with Mishra, reopened the portal to Phyrexia four thousand years earlier.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother who, with Urza, reopened the portal to Phyrexia.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Reluctant leader of the Weatherlight crew who must face his blood brother Vuel.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: The cabin boy of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: The hulking minotaur of the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: The Weatherlight's captain, kidnapped and held on Rath.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Gerrard's blood brother Vuel, who changed his name to Volrath and became Yawgmoth's first in command.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane that Yawgmoth is poised to invade.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Yawgmoth's one-time home, whose portal Urza and Mishra reopened.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: The plane to which the crew must travel to rescue Sisay.

entities.name: Weatherlight crew
entities.description: The intrepid crew who search the planes for all pieces of the Legacy before the invasion.

events.summary: Yawgmoth sits poised to invade Dominaria four thousand years after Urza and Mishra reopened the portal to Phyrexia.
events.quote: the evil lord Yawgmoth sits poised to invade his one-time home

events.summary: The Weatherlight crew searches the planes for the pieces of the Legacy before the invasion commences.
events.quote: its intrepid crew searches the planes to find all of the pieces of the Legacy before the invasion commences

events.summary: Captain Sisay is kidnapped and the crew must travel to Rath to save her.
events.quote: captain Sisay has been kidnapped, and they have to travel to the plane of Rath to save her

events.summary: Gerrard must face his blood brother Vuel, who as Volrath became Yawgmoth's first in command.

relations.note: blood brothers; Volrath was formerly Vuel
